BuildingBrush.classification: Justified extra inventory site, not a new owner.
BuildingBrush.evidence: The smoke probe transfers the brush directly into EditorInterface::setActiveBrush (editor/EditorInterface.cpp:385), which deletes the previous brush through KillCurBrush (line 355), then retains the new brush in the existing curBrush owner. EditorInterface::~EditorInterface (editor/EditorInterface_editor.cpp:680-685) calls terminate(), which deletes curBrush at lines 706-707. No second owner or separate lifetime was introduced.

VulkanContext.classification: Unresolved lane-2 ownership defect; not justified against the binding no-static-duration-owner rule.
VulkanContext.evidence: engineContext retains new VulkanContext behind a function-static pointer forever. Explicit resource teardown in GameOS/gameos/gameosmain.cpp:1402 avoids static destructor ordering and frees device resources, but never frees the heap shell and leaves its ownership process-wide.
VulkanContext.required_followup: Lane 2 should put the context under an explicit engine-session owner and expose borrowed access, preserving teardown after all island/present users and before the renderer/window dependencies expire. A static unique_ptr would still violate the owner rule.
VulkanContext.scope: GameOS is lane-2-owned and read-only for this task; no explicit file claim overrides it. No VulkanContext source was edited.

4.baseline: The existing baseline already accepts both increases; own_inventory --check is green. This does not prove the VulkanContext ownership acceptable. No ownership baseline rewrite is needed for this report.
